claude_proposed_widenings.name: set_weapon_damage_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Sun Blade 'deals Radiant damage instead of Slashing damage' — a permanent damage-type substitution on the weapon itself, not a numeric modifier. No v4 atom or surface field handles replacing the base damage type of a weapon. modify_damage_numeric only adds a signed delta; grant_resistance affects incoming damage; damage is a one-shot effect atom, not a weapon-level property.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: which deals Radiant damage instead of Slashing damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_trigger effect: typed damage with creature type filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Extra 1d8 Radiant on hit vs Undead requires an on-hit damage atom with an optional creature-type filter. OnHitTriggerMechanics.effect is typed as MasteryEffect (ModifyRollAdvantageRider | SaveGateRider | GrantWeaponAttackRider) — none of these is a typed damage expression. Widening MasteryEffect to include a damage variant with creatureTypeFilter would solve this case and generalize to other weapon-bonus-damage-vs-type patterns.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit an Undead with it, that target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: blade_toggle activation (bidirectional item-form switch)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The blade springs into or out of existence via a Bonus Action — a symmetric toggle that both enables and disables the weapon form. alter_item_kind is unidirectional (transitions to a named destination form, not a toggle). ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no 'toggle' semantic. The item's weapon capability, light emission, and all other effects are gated on the blade being present.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Bonus Action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence or make the blade disappear

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light radius adjustment (ongoing caster Magic action)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Magic action adjusts the bright/dim radii by ±5 ft within [10, 30] ft bounds. emit_light has fixed brightRadiusFeet and dimAdditionalFeet — no mutable radius field or 'resize emission' operation exists in OngoingOperation or PassiveOperation. reposition_attachment moves the origin point but does not alter emission parameters.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to expand or reduce its radius of Bright Light and Dim Light by 5 feet each, to a maximum of 30 feet each or a minimum of 10 feet each

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_weapon_property (finesse)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The blade form gives the longsword the Finesse property, which is a weapon-rule property (use STR or DEX for attack/damage) not expressible as any existing EffectAtom. There is no 'grant_weapon_property' concept in the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: this magic weapon functions as a Longsword with the Finesse property
